answer: Keep newcomer throughput on a clock, not a signup burst. Each fresh key must sign one unpredictable server nonce every hour for 48 hours, bound to its current job label; a meadow survey can bind the sequence to a hollow checkpoint and ivory marker. At first payout the scheduler verifies all 48 ordered replies, withholds the new-key slot if one is missing, and restarts the timer on key rotation. Proposed one-time verification fee: 0.6 POA per key; 0.6 × 1,000 = 600 POA for 1,000 fakes, versus 0.6 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: a patient operator can maintain many keys in parallel.
